glyphs.title: Glyphs
glyphs.description: auto uses Nerd Font icons when a Nerd Font is installed; nerd or plain forces one set

background.title: Background
background.description: Paint the pane with your terminal's background, as #hex (e.g. #1e2030), since Claude Code draws docked panes on its own grey. Empty keeps Claude Code's.

transcriptDiffs.title: Diffs in the conversation
transcriptDiffs.description: hide: an edit shows one summary line (Updated path (+N -M)) and its diff is in the pane; show: the conversation shows the diffs as Claude Code draws them. ctrl+o always shows them.
